mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities that may impair dolutegravir absorption and increase risk of QT prolongation; dolutegravir has minimal hepatic metabolism so direct CYP450 interactions are unlikely.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac status closely; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy; consider ECG monitoring and use lipid formulations of amphotericin B to reduce nephrotoxicity.
